title: От Луки 20 — Luke 20
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Тогда ___ виноградника подумал: «Что же мне делать?»
cases.translation: Then the owner of the vineyard thought, 'What shall I do?'
cases.explain: Хозяин is the subject of подумал (thought) — the one doing the thinking — so it takes the nominative, the basic dictionary form.

cases.sentence: Они выбросили его из ___ и убили.
cases.translation: They threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of) always takes the genitive → виноградника.

cases.sentence: Он послал слугу к ___, чтобы они дали причитающуюся ему часть урожая.
cases.translation: He sent a servant to the farmers so that they would give him his share of the harvest.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/toward) always takes the dative → виноградарям (dative plural).

cases.sentence: Он послал ___ к виноградарям, чтобы они дали причитающуюся ему часть урожая.
cases.translation: He sent a servant to the farmers so that they would give him his share of the harvest.
cases.explain: Слугу is the direct object of the transitive verb послал (sent) → accusative.

cases.sentence: Они не могли подловить его перед ___ ни на каком его слове.
cases.translation: They could not trap him in anything he said in front of the people.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (in front of/before) takes the instrumental → народом.

cases.sentence: Иисус учил в ___, проповедуя радостную весть.
cases.translation: Jesus was teaching in the temple, preaching the good news.
cases.explain: The preposition в meaning location (in the temple, no motion) takes the prepositional → храме.

cases.sentence: Саддукеи задают Иисусу вопрос о ___ мертвых.
cases.translation: The Sadducees ask Jesus a question about the resurrection of the dead.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) takes the prepositional → воскресении.

cases.sentence: Учители закона и первосвященники хотели немедленно арестовать его, но побоялись ___.
cases.translation: The teachers of the law wanted to arrest him at once, but they were afraid of the people.
cases.explain: The verb побояться (to be afraid of) governs the genitive case → народа.

reading.ru: В один из дней, когда Иисус учил в храме, проповедуя радостную весть, к Нему пришли первосвященники и учители закона со старейшинами.
reading.question: Who came to Jesus while he was teaching in the temple?
options: The chief priests, scribes, and elders
reading.correct: The chief priests, scribes, and elders
reading.explain: The text says the chief priests, scribes, and elders came to Jesus while he was teaching in the temple.

reading.ru: Скажите, откуда Иоанн получил свое право крестить, с небес или от людей?
reading.question: What question did Jesus ask the religious leaders in return?
options: Whether John's baptism was from heaven or from men
Whether they had paid their taxes
Whether they believed in the resurrection
Whether the Messiah was David's son
reading.correct: Whether John's baptism was from heaven or from men
reading.explain: Jesus asked whether John's right to baptize came from heaven or from men.

reading.question: What did the man in Jesus' parable do?
options: He sowed a field of wheat
reading.explain: The parable begins, "A man planted a vineyard."

reading.ru: Виноградари же избили слугу и отослали его с пустыми руками.
reading.question: What did the tenant farmers do to the first servant sent to collect the harvest?
options: They beat him and sent him away empty-handed
They gave him the full harvest
reading.correct: They beat him and sent him away empty-handed
reading.explain: The tenant farmers beat the first servant and sent him away empty-handed.

reading.ru: Они выбросили его из виноградника и убили.
reading.question: What did the farmers do to the vineyard owner's son?
options: They threw him out of the vineyard and killed him
They welcomed him as the heir
reading.correct: They threw him out of the vineyard and killed him
reading.explain: The farmers threw the son out of the vineyard and killed him.

reading.question: What Scripture does Jesus quote about the stone?
options: The stone the builders rejected became the cornerstone
The stone was thrown into the sea
A stone was rolled away from a tomb
The stone was used to build the temple
reading.correct: The stone the builders rejected became the cornerstone
reading.explain: Jesus quotes Scripture: "The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone."

reading.ru: «Вот и отдавайте Кесарева Кесарю, а Божье Богу», — сказал он им.
reading.question: What did Jesus say about paying taxes to Caesar?
options: Give to Caesar what is Caesar's, and to God what is God's
No one should pay taxes to Caesar
Only the rich should pay taxes
Taxes should be paid directly to the temple
reading.correct: Give to Caesar what is Caesar's, and to God what is God's
reading.explain: Jesus answered, "Give to Caesar what is Caesar's, and to God what is God's."

reading.question: In the Sadducees' question about the resurrection, how many brothers married the same woman?
reading.explain: The Sadducees describe seven brothers who each married the same widow.

reading.ru: Иисус ответил им, «Люди этого века женятся и выходят замуж».
reading.question: According to Jesus, who marries and is given in marriage?
reading.explain: Jesus said, "The people of this age marry and are given in marriage."

reading.ru: Они разоряют дома вдов и напоказ долго молятся.
reading.question: What did Jesus warn about the teachers of the law?
options: They devour widows' houses while making a show of long prayers
They secretly gave money to the poor
They refused to teach in the synagogues
They paid more taxes than required
reading.correct: They devour widows' houses while making a show of long prayers
reading.explain: Jesus warned that the teachers of the law devour widows' houses while making a show of long prayers.
